push.title: L 1-2 vs Abdina fc | You: 8.4
push.body:
buddskees, an 8.4 is better than most forwards managed tonight. Let's go find the next gear.

THE GOOD
+ 2 of 2 shots on target. Accuracy over ego. That's maturity.
+ Man of the Match, your 17th for us. When you play like that, the whole team stands taller.
+ Man of the Match in a losing side: the bright spot on a dark night. I'd put that on a billboard if I could afford one.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. That right there is what good teammates do.
+ Tackles won 2, up from your usual 1. Quietly brilliant, and I noticed.

THE BAD
- This loss burned our last chance in Division 3 and set up a relegation match. A team result, and it needs a team answer.
- In our wins you average 1 missed tackles; here it was 3. That's the leak in the boat.
- Lowest key passes on the team: 0 (best was BellyTb1's 2). Fixable, but only if we fix it.
- Pass accuracy: 84%. Top forwards reach 88%+. You've got the legs for it.
- Shots: 2. Raise it to 3+ and you're a difference maker.

Training ground: Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.

buddskees, write this on your hand if you have to: If you're gonna make a mistake, make it at full speed and learn it at half.

Go easy on yourself tonight. Go hard at it tomorrow. - Coach Lasso
